note: Deep-dive #14. Databricks via the 14-day trial SKU (needs a pay-as-you-go subscription, which the lab has); cluster VMs are billed: single-node job cluster, auto-terminate in 10 minutes. Unity Catalog setup in Databricks is by hand.
prepare: # owner signs in (device code), not recorded
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-14 -l westeurope -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-14 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p "synapseAdminObjectId=$(az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv)" --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json

# manual: Databricks workspace: Unity Catalog metastore if the account has none, external location on abfss://lake@<storage>.dfs.core.windows.net/ with the access connector, catalog 'lakehouse'; upload the lakehouse package and src/databricks/medallion_job.py
$env:PYTHONPATH = 'src'; python -c "from lakehouse.datagen import make_batch; make_batch(r'$env:TEMP\landing\b1', 1)"   # one truncated line and one bad currency on purpose
az storage blob upload-batch --account-name $env:MG_STORAGE14 --auth-mode login -d lake -s "$env:TEMP\landing\b1" --destination-path landing/orders --overwrite

screens.name: portal
steps: Azure portal > Resource groups > rg-mglab-deep-dive-14: the storage account (hierarchical namespace), the Databricks workspace, its access connector and the Synapse workspace
Open the storage account > Data management > Lifecycle management: the rule covers only the prefix lake/landing/
mask: resource name suffixes that carry a group hash

screens.name: databricks
steps: Open the Databricks workspace, notebook medallion_job, run it with batch_id = b1
Show the printed dict with ingested, rejected and applied counts
Catalog Explorer > lakehouse > gold > daily_sales (or the abfss path if no catalog)

screens.name: synapse
steps: Synapse Studio > Develop > open src/synapse/serving.sql and run it against a user database
Run SELECT COUNT(*) and compare with the row count shown in Databricks
mask: storage account name in the script and results

screens.name: powerbi
steps: Enable the TMDL view; open the TMDL files from src/powerbi/Contoso.SemanticModel (paste in TMDL view or open as a PBIP project)
Connect the model to the Synapse serverless endpoint in Import mode, sign in with the organisational account, refresh
Build a card for Orders and a table of Revenue by region; set the currency slicer to one currency
mask: Synapse serverless server name in Data source settings and the Power Query editor

teardown: Remove-Item $env:TEMP\landing -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:MG_STORAGE14, Env:MG_SYN14, Env:PYTHONPATH -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# manual: confirm the Databricks managed resource group (rg-mglab14-dbw-managed-...) is gone and that nothing accrues in Cost Management; close Power BI Desktop without saving a .pbix and clear its data source credentials
needs: paid:Databricks cluster VMs (trial DBUs are free)
